sites.feeText: Overnight Use: Peak Season (June 13 - Aug 31) Single Site: $36 per night Double Site: $67 per night Group Site: $80 per night (up to 25 people) Non-peak Season (Sept 01 - Sept 28) Single Site: $30 per night Double…
sites.about: Lakes Basin Campground is situated in the ruins of a mountain lodge. Some of the old stonework still exists, including steps leading into a deep swimming hole on Gray Eagle Creek. This campground is within easy reach of many trails leading to crystal clear alpine lakes.
sites.directions: From Graeagle take Highway 89 Southeast three miles to Gold Lake Highway. Proceed on Gold Lake Highway about 9 miles to the entrance to Lakes Basin Campground, Round Lake Trailhead and Mt. Elwell…

sites.name: Black Mountain Lookout Campground
sites.feeText: Overnight Use: Single Site: $25 per night Additional Vehicle Fee: $5 per vehicle per night
sites.about: Gold Lake Campground (6,400' elevation) is located along the shores of glacially carved Gold Lake. A high clearance vehicle is recommended to access most campsites. The campground is nestled in a red fir dominated mixed conifer forest.
sites.directions: Take Highway 89 southeast from Graeagle, California a couple miles. Proceed south on Gold Lake Highway for 10 miles to Gold Lake. The boating facility is next to the campground.

sites.name: Goose Lake Campground
sites.feeText: Overnight Use: Single Site: $25 per night Additional Vehicle Fee: $5 per vehicle per night
sites.about: Camp next to a wonderful lake for paddling and breathtaking scenery. Enjoy nearby hiking, biking, and equestrian trails leading to more than 20 scenic lakes.
sites.directions: Take Highway 89 southeast from Graeagle, California for two miles. Proceed south on Gold Lake Highway for 11 miles. Just past Gold Lake is the first of three entrances to Goose Lake Campground and…

sites.name: Haven Lake Campground
sites.feeText: Overnight Use: Single Site: $25 per night Additional Vehicle Fee: $5 per vehicle per night
sites.about: Haven Lake Campground has 4 campsites. Access to some campsites is via rough unpaved road. Some of the features of this area include breathtaking scenery and over 20 scenic lakes for hiking, biking, and equestrian enjoyment.
sites.directions: Take Highway 89 southeast from Graeagle, California for two miles. Proceed south on Gold Lake Highway for 11.2 miles. Just past Gold Lake and Goose Lake is the entrance to Haven Lake Campground.
